marketing_description: The DeWALT DCN930P1 framing nailer delivers reliable performance with a 58-nail capacity and a 2 to 3-1/2 inch nail length range. Its brushless motor, ergonomic soft grip handle, and 20 V MAX XR® Lithium‑Ion 5 Ah battery provide extended runtime and durability, while the tool‑free depth adjustment and selectable bump or sequential actuation allow precise countersinking. Integrated dry‑fire lockout and stall release lever enhance safety and ease of use.
